A_held_stock_trades_normally_and_later_h.description: Held stock has bars 2017-01-03→2018-01-03, then no bars, SPY continues to 2018-06-01, liquidate_at_end=False
A_held_stock_trades_normally_and_later_h.what_price_is_used_after_last_bar: last_price (last observed close, e.g., 100) persists via _last_price dict
A_held_stock_trades_normally_and_later_h.at_what_price: Not liquidated; equity = cash + qty * last_price (100) forever unless strategy sells or liquidate_at_end=True
A_held_stock_trades_normally_and_later_h.bias: Overstates equity for delisted names; last close is not recoverable after delisting

B_acquisition_ticker_rename.description: Ticker rename FB->META; bars continue under new symbol via asof, no gap
B_acquisition_ticker_rename.what_price_is_used: New symbol's bars continue, no stale price; entity lifetime handles rename, no double-count
B_acquisition_ticker_rename.note: Requires entity layer with valid_from/valid_to and asof mapping

C_confirmed_delisting_with_no_successor.description: Confirmed delisting, no successor, final bar is last tradable price
C_confirmed_delisting_with_no_successor.is_liquidated: Only at liquidate_at_end=True, at last bar's close (e.g., 100), not at -100%
C_confirmed_delisting_with_no_successor.limitation: Alpaca does not supply authoritative terminal liquidation value; last close is not recoverable after delisting. Assuming last close overstates. Do NOT invent -100% globally; define limitation explicitly.

D_long_halt_temporary_missing_bars.description: Temporary halt, missing 5 days, then resumes
D_long_halt_temporary_missing_bars.can_stale_persist: For duration of halt, then resumes at new price
D_long_halt_temporary_missing_bars.economically_justified: Partially — halt price stale but resumes; not delisting

conclusion.automatic_liquidation: Only via liquidate_at_end or strategy sell; no automatic delisting liquidation
conclusion.liquidation_price: Last bar's close if liquidate_at_end=True, otherwise stale last_price forever
conclusion.recommendation: For survivorship-aware backtest, delisted positions should be handled explicitly: either liquidate at last close with disclaimer that it overstates, or mark as -100% only with evidence, or exclude delisting return from performance and report limitation. Do NOT silently hold at last_price forever. Current engine does silently hold, which is a bias. Document as limitation and consider research for terminal-return handling.
